name: MACHER.one
author: MACHER.one

sections.description: MACHER.one is a central WordPress Suite that lets you manage backend modules like custom login design, AI media labeling, and other admin features — all from one dashboard.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Open “MACHER.one” from the admin menu to access settings and modules.
sections.faq:
Do I need MACHER.one to use sub-modules like AI Label?

Yes. MACHER.one is the main framework. Extensions such as AI Label or Backend Login require it to be active.

Is MACHER.one compatible with multilingual sites?

Yes. It follows WordPress translation standards and currently includes English only.

Can I deactivate modules independently?

Yes. Each module like “Backend Login” or “AI Media” can be enabled or disabled individually in the dashboard.
